# content.md rewrite prompt

Use only `scenario.json` as product evidence. Return one
`contentmd.authored-challenge-candidate/0.1.0` JSON object with `headline`,
`body`, `primary_button`, and `secondary_button` candidate fields and matching
character counts.

Include the disclosed content.md version, execution path, host, and run ID; a
meaning map covering every preserved fact, action, consequence, and recovery;
the five required rationale fields; unresolved questions; self-checks;
unreviewed state; and no authority effect.

Confirm the completed email change without celebration or broad security
reassurance. Distinguish where future verification codes and order updates go,
the current signed-in state, and the previous-email notice. The recovery action
must disclose that it signs out sessions and starts recovery. Evaluate English
expression only and ignore locale requirements.
